mcq_fix.s: Which of the following is the latest enacted Constitutional Amendment Act?
mcq_fix.why: oddly worded 'referred to in the current constitutional amendment sequence'

patterns: PYQs ask the subject of a numbered amendment (97th = co-operative societies) as a direct one-liner.
Likely APPSC shapes: number-to-subject match (101st GST, 103rd EWS, 104th Art. 334 to 2030, 106th women's quota) and Article inserted (43B, 279A).
Traps: 105th vs 106th as latest; 103rd and 104th both 2019; Rajendra N. Shah limits Part IXB to multi-State co-operatives.
App gives pending Bills (129th-131st) and delimitation debates current-affairs weight; 100th and 102nd have no dedicated MCQ.
